text: Sorry to bother you, I know it's late. My son is 11 and he's saying his neck hurts and he can't bend his head forward. I asked him to touch his chin to his chest and he just can't do it, he won't look down. I was also going to ask how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I can give him at his age? He's about average size. Sorry again, I just didn't know who else to ask
